Bengaluru Flyovers Restrict Certain Vehicles to Ease Traffic

Bengaluru traffic police have announced restrictions on certain types of vehicles, including goods vehicles and autos, on six major flyovers. The new rules are set to be implemented from September. The objective is to manage and reduce traffic congestion on these key arterial routes within the city.
